school_name: University of Environment and Sustainable Development
entry_note: Good first degree (at least Second Class Lower) in an appropriate field from an accredited university. A Third Class or Pass holder with at least two years' working experience may be considered after a selection interview. Applicants without a first degree may be considered if aged at least 40 with special knowledge and considerable experience, with a transcript and selection interview.
